# deed_service_account_token (Resource)

An API token (`deed_at_…`) for a service account. Every argument forces a new token; destroying it revokes the token. Requires Deed 0.2.0 or newer and an installation `admin` (or owner) token, which may be a service account token itself, so Terraform can rotate its own credential.

The secret is a sensitive computed attribute and is therefore stored in the Terraform state: keep the state encrypted, or create the first token with `deed admin token` on the Deed host and store it only in your secret manager.

Rotation: the token is replaced when it is revoked or expired outside Terraform, when it expires within `rotate_before_days`, or when a value in `keepers` changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "deed_service_account_token" "dashboards" {
  service_account    = deed_service_account.dashboards.name
  name               = "grafana"
  expires_in_days    = 366
  rotate_before_days = 30 # replaced on the first apply within 30 days of expiry

  # Create the new token before the old one is revoked.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Hand the token to whatever needs it, for example a secret manager.
output "dashboards_token" {
  value     = deed_service_account_token.dashboards.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token name, shown in the UI. Changing it forces a new token.
- `service_account` (String) Service account ID or name. Changing it forces a new token.

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime in days (default 90, at most Deed's `auth.max_token_lifetime`, 366 by default). Changing it forces a new token.
- `installation_role` (String) Installation role of the token: `admin`, `auditor` or `none` (project memberships only). Defaults to the service account's role; it can never exceed it. Changing it forces a new token.
- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that force a new token when they change (for example a rotation date).
- `project_role` (String) Caps every project role of the token: `viewer`, `editor` or `admin`. Changing it forces a new token.
- `projects` (Set of String) Restrict the token to these projects (names or IDs). Omit for every project the account can access. Changing it forces a new token.
- `rotate_before_days` (Number) Replace the token on the next apply once it expires within this many days. Omit to replace it only after it has expired.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Token ID (`atk_…`).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token (`deed_at_…`). Sensitive; stored in state.
- `user_id` (String) User ID of the service account.
